title: Seaweed Soup · Course 2
source: GGYC Seaweed Soup 2026–27, Addendum B. Mark positions from YRA (github.com/nkiesel/YRA-Marks).
notes: GGYC Seaweed Soup 2026–27, Addendum B. About 3.2 nm. Start westward off the GGYC race deck. Pass X on the side shown to keep clear of the line; it is not a rounding mark. Crossing the line mid-race is a two-turn penalty. Marks are at YRA positions; the line runs from the race deck out to X, an assumption to check against the sailing instructions.
